title: トレセン学園百人一首クイーン決定戦

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I head to the classroom searching for Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ahem, here we go. "I think upon you, as I—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Outta the way, Spe! I GOT THIS!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El, that isn't even close to the correct card. You just earned yourself a penalty.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh? I coulda sworn the poem went like that.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. The academy is holding a karuta contest soon, so we're practicing matching poetry verses to their continuations.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's right! Grass is really, really good!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But, um… El is a little—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A little what?! It's not like you're any better at this, Spe!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: How are we supposed to remember all these so-called poems anyways? They all just sound like lazy run-on sentences to me!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You couldn't be more mistaken, El. Each one tells a unique story. This one, for instance…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I think upon you, as I take to the springtide fields, harvesting new greens. The sleeve of my robe collects its own share of falling snow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It paints a scene of someone gathering fresh greens for the one they love as winter fades into spring.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There's something beautiful about how it depicts not the peak of spring, but the subtle transition between seasons.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh… I never would've guessed. If you ask me, snow during springtime sounds like a pain…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: What's beautiful about pickin' veggies? I mean I could maaaybe see it if they were red-hot peppers or something fun, but c'mon…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That would get you excited, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Still, what I want to say is: visualizing what the poem depicts can make memorizing it easier.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah! You might be right! You're amazing, Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All right, Grass! Do another round! I'll snag the right card for sure this time!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Very well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know. This game is more fun with more players. Would you care to join us, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'll take you up on that.
I'll take over as game master so you can play, Grass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Great. I'll continue as the reader, then.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I hope you're good at this, Grass's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Bet ya can't flip the cards faster than me though!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I join them all playing the verse-matching card game.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. This one is absolutely exquisite, so please try to visualize the story as you listen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It portrays the traditional Japanese appreciation for fleeting beauty, illustrated in the contrast between—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Graaass! It's awesome that you know so much, but…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: This is gonna take forever if ya keep explainin' each one before we start!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The game lasts longer than everyone had intended, but Grass Wonder is beaming with joy the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, good idea! After all that practice, we might be able to put up a fight against Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Uh, S-Spe?! You probably don't wanna go saying things like—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, isn't that an idea? Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And of course, I'm sure nobody will mind if I give this my all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Why does her smile look so scary?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, the poem-matching card game recommences.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There—it seems like I've won. El, you didn't even manage to claim a single card.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: NGGGHHH! One more round! We're doin' this again!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I knew Grass was gonna be good, but this good? I don't think anyone could beat her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The way Grass Wonder dominated this practice session, she should be unstoppable in the contest.
